object_layout_version.description:
Version of the deterministic object key/payload/epoch contract. Keep
this pinned while uncommitted source data can replay.

max_epoch_buffers.description: Soft deterministic limit for open objects in one partition actor.

max_buffered_bytes.description: Soft admission limit for serialized bytes in one partition actor.

max_epoch_bytes.description:
Stable limit for serialized payload plus retained routing metadata in
one epoch. Metadata is measured as its UTF-8 lengths plus a fixed
128-byte logical overhead per row, independent of Rust's ABI. When
omitted, the limit is derived only from sink configuration, never from
in-memory delivery state.

max_in_flight_objects.description: Maximum concurrent object uploads in one partition actor.

operation_timeout.description: Deadline applied independently to each object-store request.
